dedupe_keys.name: permian basin produced water and pecos river chemistry

description: This deposit combines chemistry measurements from forty-six produced-water samples and ten Pecos River samples in the Permian Basin, United States. New Mexico State University researchers analyse twenty-four produced-water samples and all river samples, while industrial collaborators supply the remaining twenty-two produced-water observations. Reported analytes include salts, metals, hydrocarbons, radionuclides, ammonia, fracturing additives and PFAS. Mendeley version 4 provides one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Sampling covers five produced-water locations; the brief repository metadata do not identify a common calendar span. Combining laboratory and industry sources creates methodological differences that should be checked before estimating treatment requirements. Concentrations also do not directly establish safe reuse limits. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying feed-water quality ranges to treatment and water-reuse scenarios. platform-sei-weap-water-evaluation-and-adaptation-planning is a related water-allocation resource that would require additional quality and treatment assumptions. No workbook, chemical analysis or reuse scenario was executed.
